# Security & Data-Safety Requirements Checklist: Repair the music library

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements — is the outbound allowlist, credential safety and data-loss safety of the repair worker specified completely, clearly and measurably? Release gate; reviewer audience.
**Created**: 2026-09-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Gaps found during generation were fixed in the spec/tasks (FR-003, FR-006, FR-007, FR-010, FR-014, FR-015, new FR-021/FR-022, SC-009/SC-010) and are marked below as resolved.

## Credential & Log Safety

- [x] CHK001 Is it stated what the worker stores, what crosses to the NAS, and what may appear in logs or errors? [Completeness, Spec §Credential-Safety Impact]
- [x] CHK002 Is the content of an outbound request bounded to artist, title and a User-Agent, with nothing account-related? [Clarity, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK003 Is it specified that tag contents (video descriptions) and full request URLs are never logged? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, §Credential-Safety Impact]
- [x] CHK004 Are the worker's cluster privileges specified (no API access, same unprivileged user as download workers)? [Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK005 Is the cache constrained to derived public facts with no credential or user id? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK006 Is it explicit that no SynoDL state, second datastore or server permission is added? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Outbound Allowlist & Redirects

- [x] CHK007 Are the permitted hosts enumerated, including the hosts the four services redirect to or serve images from? [Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-015, Research §R4]
- [x] CHK008 Is HTTPS-only stated, and is a look-alike host (`evilarchive.org`) excluded by a stated matching rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK009 Is redirect handling specified — every hop re-checked and the number of hops bounded? [Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK010 Is the allowlist required to be separate from the catalog image proxy's list? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK011 Are source rate limits and identification required, and is a failing source distinguished from "no match"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK012 Is downloaded artwork required to be verified by content and size-bounded? [Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK013 Is "no request to a non-allowlisted host" measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]

## Untrusted Input & Path Confinement

- [x] CHK014 Is every tag/title/playlist-derived value declared untrusted and sanitised before becoming a path component? [Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK015 Is it specified that a plan step may not name a path outside the library (absolute, `..`, symlink)? [Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK016 Is scanning required not to follow symbolic links? [Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK017 Are control characters and line breaks from titles excluded from playlist files? [Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK018 Is the reuse of the recipe's own sanitising rule specified so the two cannot disagree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Research §R7]

## Data-Loss Safety

- [x] CHK019 Is "nothing permanently deleted" stated, with where removed files go and that the repair never empties it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK020 Is restoring specified for tags as well as files (previous tag values recorded)? [Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-007, §SC-010]
- [x] CHK021 Is restore's behaviour defined when the original location is occupied? [Edge Case, Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK022 Is "stale" defined precisely (size, modified time, destination exists) and its outcome (skip and report, never force) stated? [Ambiguity → resolved, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK023 Is it specified that apply runs only a plan named by id and never without one? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK024 Are concurrent runs addressed, including a lock left by a crashed run? [Gap → resolved, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK025 Are resumption after interruption and idempotence stated and measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK026 Is free-space verification required before apply, with the shortfall reported? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK027 Is it stated which files are never modified (`.ytdlp-archive.txt`, `.nfo` except orphans) and is that measurable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, §SC-008]
- [x] CHK028 Is "no song lost" measurable (every video id present after or in `.trash`)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK029 Is the dry run required to change nothing, and is that verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001, §SC-003]

## Assumptions & Dependencies

- [x] CHK030 Is the pre-apply snapshot recorded as an operator assumption, distinct from `.trash` protection? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK031 Is `.trash` growth documented as the operator's to manage? [Assumption → resolved, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK032 Are the external sources' availability and terms stated as dependencies with a degradation path? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-013]

## Notes

- 32 items; 14 of them were gaps or ambiguities in the first draft and are now resolved in the spec.
- The confidence rule's trade-off (many popular songs stay in `Singles`) is a quality decision recorded in research R5, not a security gap.
